stages.title: Cut the guanciale
stages.caption: Even batons with pale fat and pink meat; remove the tough skin before cutting.

stages.title: Mix eggs and Pecorino
stages.caption: A thick, cohesive egg-and-cheese base speckled with black pepper; no dry pockets of cheese.

stages.title: Render until golden
stages.caption: Golden, crisp-edged guanciale surrounded by a pool of clear rendered fat.

stages.title: Bring water to a rolling boil
stages.caption: Large bubbles break across the surface of the salted pasta water.

stages.title: Cook and reserve pasta water
stages.caption: Flexible spaghetti in the pot, with starchy water set aside before draining. Taste to judge the firm core.

stages.title: Loosen into a glossy ribbon
stages.caption: Warm egg-and-cheese sauce loosened with pasta water, flowing in a smooth ribbon rather than forming curds.

stages.title: Toss off the heat
stages.caption: Spaghetti and crisp guanciale coated in a fluid egg-Pecorino sauce; the skillet is off the heat.

stages.title: Twirl, finish, and serve
stages.caption: A nest of glossy spaghetti with crisp guanciale, grated Pecorino, and cracked black pepper.

stages.title: Beat the eggs
stages.caption: Three eggs beaten with a pinch of salt into a uniform yellow mixture; a fork rests in the bowl.

stages.title: Stir soft curds
stages.caption: Small soft egg curds gather in the skillet while the surrounding egg remains glossy and yellow, with no browned patches.

stages.title: Roll without browning
stages.caption: A pale yellow rolled French omelette has a smooth glossy surface and a light scattering of the optional chopped chives.

stages.title: Layer cheddar and bread
stages.caption: Two sandwich-bread slices on the board: one shows mayonnaise spread on its outside face, and the other holds cheddar for the filling.

stages.title: Turn the golden side up
stages.caption: The flipped sandwich shows an evenly golden first side; cheddar is softening and peeking out around the bread in the skillet.

stages.title: Slice diagonally
stages.caption: The rested grilled cheese is cut into two triangular halves, with golden bread and melted cheddar visible along the cut edges.

stages.title: Fold a lumpy batter
stages.caption: The wet and dry mixtures have been folded together into pale batter with small lumps; a spatula rests in the mixing bowl.

stages.title: Watch the bubbles open
stages.caption: Two pancakes show many popped bubbles and dry-looking rims on the griddle; a turned pancake shows its golden-brown underside.

stages.title: Butter and maple syrup
stages.caption: A stack of golden pancakes is served with butter and maple syrup, with the browned edges visible around the stack.

stages.title: Keep the garlic pale
stages.caption: Pale garlic pieces sit in olive oil in the saucepan; crushed tomatoes are ready in a separate bowl to add next.

stages.title: Simmer and stir
stages.caption: Thickening crushed-tomato sauce has a few gentle surface bubbles; the wooden spoon draws a brief curved trail through the sauce.

stages.title: Finish with basil and oil
stages.caption: The thick marinara fills a serving bowl, with torn basil and ribbons of olive oil over the visibly textured crushed tomatoes.

stages.title: Halve and scoop
stages.caption: Dragon fruit is halved lengthwise. A spoon follows the pink peel to lift out the white, black-seeded flesh in one piece.

stages.title: Cube and slice
stages.caption: Peeled dragon fruit is cut into even bite-size cubes; banana and kiwi are sliced before the bowls are assembled.

stages.title: Yogurt breakfast bowl
stages.caption: Greek yogurt is topped with dragon fruit cubes, banana, kiwi, granola, and a light drizzle of honey.

title: Mango Sticky Rice with Hedgehog-Cut Mango

stages.title: Score the mango cheeks
stages.caption: Mango cheeks are cut close to the flat pit, then crosshatched without piercing the skin. One cheek is turned inside out to lift its cubes.

stages.title: Fold in coconut sauce
stages.caption: Cooked glutinous rice receives half of the warmed coconut milk, sugar, and salt sauce; it will rest covered for ten minutes. The remaining sauce is reserved for serving.

stages.title: Rice, mango, sesame
stages.caption: Sticky coconut rice is plated beside the hedgehog-cut mango and finished with reserved coconut sauce and toasted sesame seeds.

stages.title: Open along the ridges
stages.caption: The pomegranate skin is scored from crown to base along its natural ridges, then opened into sections with the white pith still attached to the peel.

stages.title: Release arils in water
stages.caption: Pomegranate sections are loosened in a bowl of water: red arils settle below while loose white pith floats and is skimmed away. Oranges are peeled and sliced into rounds.

stages.title: Arrange the citrus salad
stages.caption: Arugula, peeled orange rounds, ruby pomegranate arils, and mint are arranged on a platter with olive oil, lemon, honey, and salt dressing.

stages.title: Trim the leaves and stem
stages.caption: Artichoke tops are cut off, sharp leaf tips are clipped flat, and tough green stem skin is peeled away to the pale center. Lemon is rubbed on the cut surfaces.

stages.title: Steam until tender
stages.caption: Two trimmed artichokes steam above water in a covered pot for about 35 minutes, until a leaf pulls away easily. The lid is set aside in this instructional view.

stages.title: Clear the hearts and serve
stages.caption: Cooked artichokes are halved and the fuzzy choke is scraped away, revealing smooth hearts. The halves are served warm with mayonnaise, lemon, garlic, and salt aioli.

stages.title: Remove cores and shred
stages.caption: Drained young green jackfruit is separated from its firm triangular cores. The softer pieces are pulled into distinct strands rather than mashed.

stages.title: Simmer and brown the strands
stages.caption: Shredded jackfruit cooks with softened onion, garlic, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, orange juice, and soy sauce. Lightly browned edges remain visibly fibrous.

stages.title: Fill warm corn tortillas
stages.caption: Corn tortillas hold saucy, lightly browned jackfruit strands and fresh cilantro, with lime wedges alongside for squeezing.

stages.title: Center the filling
stages.caption: Squeezed napa cabbage is mixed with pork, scallions, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil and white pepper. A small teaspoon mound leaves a clean border on the dumpling wrapper.

stages.title: Fold and seal
stages.caption: Moisten the wrapper edge with water, fold it over the filling, then pleat one side against the other. The even pleats form a fully sealed edge without filling squeezing out.

stages.title: Golden, steamed and crisped
stages.caption: Dumplings are browned flat-side down, steamed with water under a lid, then uncovered until the water evaporates and the bottoms re-crisp. Serve with dumpling dipping sauce; several are turned to show the browned base.

title: Roast Turkey Breast with Pan Gravy

stages.title: Herb-butter roasting pan
stages.caption: Thyme-and-lemon herb butter is spread under and over the unbroken skin of the bone-in turkey breast. Onion, carrot and celery support the breast in the roasting pan, ready for the 350°F oven.

stages.title: Rest the roast, whisk gravy
stages.caption: Roast at 350°F for about 90 minutes, checking doneness with a thermometer—not skin color—before resting 20 minutes. Whisk butter and flour, then skimmed drippings and stock; simmer until the gravy coats a spoon and pours in a smooth ribbon.

stages.title: Carve across the grain
stages.caption: After thermometer-verified cooking and the 20-minute rest, carve the breast from the bone and cut even slices about ¼ inch thick across the grain. Pan gravy is served alongside; the drawing does not establish doneness.

title: Whole Roasted Branzino with Citrus and Herbs

stages.title: Score and loosely stuff
stages.caption: Two dried branzino are scored three times per side, seasoned with salt, pepper and olive oil, then loosely filled with lemon slices, parsley and fennel fronds without bulging the cavities.

stages.title: Roast until blistered
stages.caption: Roast the stuffed fish on a sheet pan at 425°F for about 18 minutes. The recipe asks for blistered skin and a fork check at the thickest point for flesh near the backbone that flakes when nudged; this illustration cannot verify doneness.

stages.title: Lift broad fillets
stages.caption: A fish spatula and spoon lift the top fillets cleanly from the bones in broad pieces. Serve the branzino fillets with lemon wedges and olive oil; the plate depicts lifted fillets rather than the skeleton.
